title: Selection Sort
problemStatement: Sort an array using Selection Sort.
intuition: For position i, select the minimum in a[i..] and swap it into place. After i steps, a[0..i-1] is the smallest i elements in order.

approaches.title: Selection sort
approaches.idea: i from 0..n-2; find min index in i..n-1; swap with i.
approaches.whyWorks: Invariant: prefix a[0..i-1] holds the i smallest elements sorted.

commonMistakes: Thinking it is adaptive / early-exit like bubble
patternRecognition: Teaching sort; not used for n=1e5 (TLE)
followUps: Stable? (no — equal elements can swap order)
When is O(n²) with O(1) space acceptable?
interviewInsight: Know selection vs bubble vs insertion tradeoffs (swaps, stability, adaptive).
flagsNote: O(n²) → TLE for large n; interview teaching only
